result.title: AVTime: Reinforcing Dense Audio-Visual Captions with Bidirectional Alignment
result.summary: Dense temporal audio-visual captioning is important for multimodal video understanding and generation. However, prior work is constrained by three main limitations: (1) the lack of a dataset combining high temporal resolution, longer videos, and bidirectional alignment between time and events; (2) the reliance of most existing RL methods on checklists; and (3) the lack of a benchmark that bidirectionally evaluates event semantic correctness and temporal accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose: (1) AVTime-50K, a high-quality 50K-scale dataset with temporally precise, semantically accurate captions and longer videos; (2) AVTime, a state-of-the-art model optimized with a novel Bidirectional Temporal-Semantic Alignment (BiTSA) reward that imposes explicit bidirectional constraints between time and events; and (3) AVTime-Bench, a specialized benchmark that introduces a novel bidirectional evaluation of temporal accuracy and semantic correctness. Our code, models, and datasets are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Apryle/avtime.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了 5 万规模、含长视频与时间精确描述的 AVTime-50K 数据集，提出以「双向时序-语义对齐」（BiTSA）奖励进行 RL 优化的 AVTime 模型，并配套双向评测时间准确性与语义正确性的 AVTime-Bench 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 BiTSA 奖励在时间与事件之间施加显式双向约束，可能为 LVR 中推理状态与视觉证据的对应性监督、时间定位贡献分配提供可供核查的训练线索；但论文本身聚焦音视频描述质量，未涉及 latent 推理状态。
